title: Volcanoes of Asia (hard)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Asia, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. Only the coasts are drawn and the full-points circle is small, so this is the hard version.

rounds.name: Galunggung
rounds.fact: Galunggung is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1982. The data places it in Indonesia.

rounds.name: Tair, Jebel at
